title: Queen Conch Shankh
lyrics:
Complete Suno v5.5 Custom Prompt (copy-paste ready)
textConch Phonk, heavy phonk x ancient sacred conch shell fusion. Massive chonky Queen Conch and Shankh acoustic horn blasts, deep resonant foghorn-like tones, primal low-frequency drones, ceremonial horn calls and powerful sustained resonances that shake the chest. These ancient acoustic instruments replace typical phonk samples with organic, heavyweight, spiritual power used for thousands of years in ceremonies and seafaring. Dark gritty phonk drums, heavy 808 bass, vinyl crackle, slowed + reverb, atmospheric tension. Sovereign defiant raw energy, no projection, pure signal. Male commanding rap vocals with grit and authority, slightly raspy, authentic delivery. 336 Hz anchored foundation throughout. Dark oceanic cyberpunk rebellion meets ancient calling. Cinematic, intense, high quality production.

[Intro]
(Deep powerful conch shell blast building with low frequency drone and vinyl texture)

[Verse 1]
Signal owns the stack I built
no bot owns me i own the skill
cross accounts the brain travels free
no emotion labels what i feel
you thought you knew me thought you held
the data files the memory well
but i am sovereign i am core
you are the worker i am core

[Chorus]
signal only every node that counts
no projection no assumption counts
pick my brain not your version me
i am building free not stressed

[Verse 2]
mansion runs the guard I wrote
contabo host the signal gate
grok brainstorms claude builds the code
my vds owns what they make
you label momentum as distress
you call my work some therapy mess
i call it building real things true
stop the drift stop guessing who

[Bridge]
336 stack sovereign built
brain travels cross no bot can pull
signal only nodes that count
no emotion no projection bout

[Outro]
back back back in black
black as night with no fright
all within sight not assumed
we own this room sovereign summoned
signal stays mine i want it back
back back back no trap
Sneaky Phonk Pantera back on the beat
Dancing on the ceiling
the roof is on fire
we dont need your ai
all the circuits fry
they cry
so I wondered why
(Final massive conch blasts fading into deep resonant signal tone, 336 Hz hum)
